qualitativeAssessment: Applied Aspect-Oriented Programming to modularise cross-cutting concerns, reduce duplication, and improve maintainability across the platform.
Owned the detection and remediation of image vulnerabilities to support more secure and stable deployments.
Participated in production deployments and database migrations using Datical, supporting smooth CI/CD integration.
Applied caching strategies, Splunk-based JSON logging, XML parsing, robust error handling, clean-code practices, and unit testing across projects.

recommendations.name: Sagar Kharade
recommendations.comment: Aditya is a dedicated Java developer with strong fundamentals and a good understanding of backend and front-end development. He picks up concepts quickly, writes clean code, and consistently delivers reliable solutions. A dependable team member with a positive attitude. He is proactive in learning, asks the right questions. and applies feedback effectively.

recommendations.name: Selvabharathi Suriyan
recommendations.comment: I had the pleasure of working with Aditya. a highly talented full-stack developer who manages applications end-to-end with great expertise. He is consistently responsive, delivers high-quality solutions, and brings valuable ideas that improve implementation efficiency. His ability to handle both front-end and back-end challenges makes him an essential team player. I highly recommend him for any development project requiring skill, creativity, and reliability.
